Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the roadway in Pasadena, Texas, waiting for traffic ahead to clear, when the
vehicle directly behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle at moderate speed. Driver 1 reported
pain in the left wrist after the impact and was transported for evaluation. The reported wrist injury is consistent with
the forces expected in a collision of this type. Two independent witnesses at the scene stated that the collision
occurred as Driver 1 described, and photographs taken at the scene show rear-end damage to the bumper, trunk lid
and tail lamp assembly that matches the direction and force of the impact. Driver 2 gave a statement confirming the
sequence of events. Driver 1 is named on the auto policy covering the damaged vehicle. No prior damage to the
vehicle was observed or reported by any party. A Passenger was present in the front seat, and it was not fully clear
from the statements where Driver 1 was seated at the moment of impact, which the investigating officer noted for
follow-up.
